texts.en:
The people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] are delighted with the technology we have been sharing with them. They have flocked to the enclaves we established on the surface of their world, bombarding our scientists with questions about our culture and history.

The eagerness of the [pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to learn more about us has accelerated our mission to advance the technological progress of their civilization. We have revised our initial time estimates.

# 科技发展：[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的进展 / Technological Development: Progress on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 观察站（前FTL观察）事件 pre-FTL observation event
- 来源 Sources：`events/observation_events.txt:4315-4388` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:563-575`

## 如何开始 How it starts

五年一次的前FTL科技事件池 on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl_tech_events（权重 10/270，`00_on_actions.txt:563–575`）。条件：存在被我方“开放科技启蒙”（或被间谍行动盯上）的前FTL国家，其物种具有 “快速学习者”特质，且尚未设置 quick_learners_development 标志。/ Entry: the five-year pre-FTL tech pool (weight 10 of 270). Needs an observed country under open technological enlightenment whose species has trait_quick_learners and no quick_learners_development flag.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

**科技发展：[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的进展**：隐藏效果标记该国并给其科技情境 +384（相当于一次进度）；唯一选项仅作确认。/ Flags the country and changes its tech-progress situation by +384; the only option acknowledges.

线性，单事件。/ Single event.
